svg.aria-label: Username and password: Email and phone are optional, encrypted, and never used by the service. Encrypted on your device: Messages, photos, profiles and group names are sealed before they leave. Web Crypto plus Argon2id. The server is blind: It keeps hashes, public keys and ciphertext, plus only the few facts it needs to enforce group rules. No tracking: No analytics, no third-party requests, no access logs, no IP addresses on disk. Protected chats: The desktop app keeps protected chats out of screenshots and screen recordings. Honest about limits: It never promises what a platform can't deliver, like blocking screenshots in a browser.
svg.title: How Tacenza works
